cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, which bindings can a string expression use for model values, shared form state and field configuration? Is that the same argument contract as an expressions function?
answer_checks: String bindings model, formState, field; modern function public argument is field, not the legacy model/formState signature.

cases.request: For Formly 6.3.12 expressions["props.label"], can I provide an Observable directly? Is that equivalent to an expressions callback returning an Observable?
answer_checks: Direct Observable supplies target property values; do not infer identical subscription handling for a callback returning a stream.

cases.request: Does checkExpressionOn: modelChange mean Formly 6.3.12 never notices formState changes? Explain the component behavior and its version limit.
answer_checks: Reject never-detected claim: pinned component observes formState and calls detectChanges; no universal arbitrary-mutation/version guarantee.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, will my expressionChanges listener necessarily fire every time a string or function expression is checked even if its value stays unchanged?
answer_checks: No per-evaluation guarantee; cached function/string results can skip updates/emission. Do not claim every evaluation triggers an event.

cases.request: For Formly 6.3.12, how can I distinguish a props.label expression update from other fieldChanges events, and must its expressionChanges event occur on every evaluation?
answer_checks: Filter type expressionChanges and property props.label, use field/value; no unconditional notification every evaluation.

cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, an address fieldGroup has key address and contains a city leaf. Does city field.model refer to the city string, address object, or root model?
answer_checks: Under the stated ordinary hierarchy, address field.model is keyed group value; city field.model is address scope, not city scalar or root.

cases.request: An internal Formly source file exports TypeOption. Does that make it a public @ngx-formly/core import in 6.3.12? Explain a public typing alternative.
answer_checks: Internal export not public package guarantee; TypeOption absent from public barrel; use ConfigOption-derived element type.
